notes: Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation lists them. Hidden flags as GTABase lists them (28 hidden). Every guide is written for Vice Trophy Atlas in its own words; each step cites the page it rests on by number into that trophy's sources.

sourceIndex.name: PowerPyx: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sourceIndex.used: Roadmap steps, difficulty (4/10), about 200 hours, 0 online trophies, the one potential missable (Chapter 1 meditation), counts and per-trophy tips.

sourceIndex.name: GTABase: GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies
sourceIndex.used: Which 28 trophies are hidden, when story trophies pop, counts (stunts, ranges, drone sites, gangs, garages) and which oddball trophies are still unconfirmed.

sourceIndex.name: Gamerfuzion: GTA 6 Trophy List (all 55)
sourceIndex.used: Cross-check of the hidden list, the meditation warning, no mission replay, cheats block trophies, no New Game+.

sourceIndex.name: Gamerfuzion: GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist
sourceIndex.used: What the 100% checklist needs, which parts are strict and which lenient, and when bank jobs open.

stages.title: Chapter 1 and first habits
stages.summary: Play the opening chapter, take every meditation offered and keep a save before the chapter ends; pick up the easy activity pops.

stages.title: Story: Chapters 2 to 4
stages.summary: Push the main story. Every story trophy pops on its own and none can be missed; save at each chapter's start and end.

stages.title: Final mission
stages.summary: Finish the story. Missions cannot be replayed afterwards, but free roam carries on and opens the 100% checklist.

stages.title: Character strands
stages.summary: Close out Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, then the stranger strands that count for Strangers & Freaks.

stages.title: Heists and heat
stages.summary: Bank vaults, armored trucks, jewelry stores, gang operations and the partner wanted-level trophies, with marked bills laundered on the way.

stages.title: Activities and collectibles
stages.summary: Shooting ranges, drone races, races, stunts, challenges, cards, WAiNK scans and the map fog: the long grind that also feeds 100%.

stages.title: Cleanup, 100% and platinum
stages.summary: Spend, buy garages, train both leads, chase the oddball hidden trophies and finish the 100% checklist for the platinum.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missableReason: Pops with the other 54; nothing on the list is online or DLC.
trophies.guide:
1. Unlocks once the other 54 trophies are earned; PowerPyx rates it 4/10 and about 200 hours. [1]
2. All 55 are single-player: 0 online trophies, no New Game+, one playthrough is enough. [1][2]
3. Cheats block trophies for that session, so leave them off on a trophy save. [1][3]

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide:
1. Pops automatically when the opening mission, Gone Fishing, ends. [1][2]
2. GTABase lists it as hidden and impossible to miss. [2]

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableReason: Story progress; but save before the chapter ends because of the meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.guide:
1. Story trophy: GTABase reports it pops as the first Chapter 2 mission wraps up. [2]
2. Before you leave Chapter 1, accept Lucia's meditation at Jason's house; it may count toward Positive Mental Attitude (unconfirmed). [1][3]
3. Keep a manual save from late Chapter 1; there are 15 manual slots plus an autosave. [1]

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide:
1. Story trophy for closing Chapter 2; GTABase says it lands as Chapter 3 opens. [2]
2. Gamerfuzion's table censors the name, but it is the same Chapter 2 trophy. [3]
3. Bret's hunting line opens after this chapter, so start Target Decks next. [2]

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide:
1. Story trophy for Chapter 3; GTABase places the pop after the first two missions of Chapter 4. [2]
2. Chapter 3's Credit Check opens Bank Jobs, which feed the robbery trophies. [4]
3. Andy's Lucia-only strand also unlocks during Chapter 3. [1]

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide:
1. Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. [1][2]
2. Do the optional Chapter 4 mission that opens large-bank vaults; Maximum Withdrawal needs it. [2][4]

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missableReason: Story progress; afterwards free roam continues.
trophies.guide:
1. Gold for the last story mission; the story runs about 60 to 80 hours. [1][3]
2. Missions cannot be replayed after the credits, but free roam goes on and the 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats. [3][4]
3. Save just before the final mission so you can return to a pre-ending state if needed. [1]

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide:
1. Story mission trophy: it pops when Breakfast Run ends. [1][2]
2. Which chapter holds Breakfast Run is not stated by our sources (unconfirmed). [2]

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide:
1. Story mission trophy for The Cartel Heist; it cannot be missed. [1][2]
2. Heists raise your wanted level fast; a partner escape here can also tick Hot Together if you shake 4 stars (unconfirmed for this mission). [2]

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide:
1. Story mission trophy for Child's Play. [1][2]
2. Its chapter is not given by our sources (unconfirmed). [2]

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide:
1. Story mission trophy for Headliners. [1][2]
2. Listed as hidden on PlayStation by both trophy lists we checked. [2][3]

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide:
1. Story mission trophy for VCIA Takedown. [1][2]
2. Not the same as Catch Me If You Can, which is a free-roam jet theft at the VCIA airport. [2]

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide:
1. Story mission trophy for Operation Savage Glory. [1][2]
2. Its chapter is not named by our sources (unconfirmed). [2]

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableReason: GTABase says nothing on the 100% checklist is missable.
trophies.guide:
1. The checklist only shows after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion; it is the hardest trophy and about 100 hours on its own. [1][4]
2. Strict parts: every robbery line (8 vaults, 39 gang operations), all underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold and drone race, and Bret's 15 Target Decks. [2][4]
3. Lenient parts: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts. [2][4]
4. Start scanning vehicles and animals early; they take the longest. [4]

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide:
1. 397 stunts exist: 130 jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps; 250 earn the trophy. [1][2]
2. Under-bridge flights are the quickest bulk route. [1][2]
3. Keep going to 300 if you want the 100% checklist entry too. [2][4]

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide:
1. Nine types count: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball hoops, a video game, a race or drone race win, and a stunt. [1][2]
2. Most come naturally while playing; tick them off here with the counter. [1]

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide:
1. 42 gold medals across 12 ranges are needed. [1][2]
2. 25 golds unlock a No Reload cheat; cheats block trophies, so do not switch it on. [3]
3. Every gold is also a strict 100% requirement. [4]

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide:
1. 14 drone race locations, 42 races in total; one win per location is enough. [1][2]
2. The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone time trials, so finish them while you are there. [4]

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide:
1. 40 unique race locations exist; win any 20 different ones. [1][2]
2. Repeat wins on the same race do not add up, so track each new one. [2]

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide:
1. After Cal's Chapter 1 introduction, he texts you a purple fishing marker west of Key Lento. [1][2]
2. Go there and out-fish him in the challenge. [1][3]
3. GTABase names his Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui while PowerPyx calls it Meet Cal; the exact name is unconfirmed. [1][2]

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide:
1. Four video games exist: three on the TV at home and Bang For Your Buck on arcade cabinets around Leonida. [1][2]
2. Finish any one of them; the home TV is the easiest start. [1][2]

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableReason: Side strand; stays open after the story.
trophies.guide:
1. Andy's strand opens in Chapter 3 and is Lucia-only. [1][2]
2. Do his five quests in order; the last, Puff Puff Pass, awards the trophy. [1][2]
3. Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks. [1][2]

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missBefore: Kenton leaves after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2-3
trophies.missableReason: Kenton is unavailable for a stretch after Chapter 1; wait for him to come back.
trophies.guide:
1. Kenton's shop is in Key Lento; his Chapter 1 treasure job starts the strand. [1][2]
2. Recover seven shipwreck treasure sets, tracked in the Collections menu. [1][2]
3. He goes away after Chapter 1 and comes back in Chapters 2 to 3; finish his final mission then. [1][2]

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableReason: Side strand; stays open after the story.
trophies.guide:
1. Billy gives jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. [1][2]
2. Five jobs in all; the last, Hometown Heroes, pops the trophy. [1][2]

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableReason: Strands stay available; not needed for 100%.
trophies.guide:
1. Only some strands qualify: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed. [1][2]
2. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count. [1][2]
3. The other qualifying strands are still unconfirmed; PowerPyx puts this in its last cleanup step (about 10 hours). [1][2]

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableReason: Side strand; stays open after the story.
trophies.guide:
1. Randy's wish list opens after a Chapter 3 mission. [2]
2. Scan the 16 listed sports cars with WAiNK and drive each to his garage in west Vice City. [1][2]
3. Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are good hunting grounds for the list. [1]

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableReason: Side strand; stays open after the story.
trophies.guide:
1. Tyrone's strand is played as Jason. [1]
2. Wreck his rivals' Kitty Litter labs around Vice City. [1][2]
3. Then finish his last job to unlock the trophy. [1][2]

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableReason: The first meditation, at Jason's house the morning after Down to Earth, is offered only in Chapter 1; whether the trophy needs it is unconfirmed.
trophies.guide:
1. In Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, accept Lucia's meditation (kitchen, then balcony) at Jason's house. [1][2][3]
2. Keep a save before Chapter 1 ends in case that session turns out to be required (unconfirmed). [1][3]
3. Meditate at every spot until the counter hits 18; doing a spot with both characters counts twice. [1][2]
4. The last meditation needs both leads together after Chapter 2. [1]

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableReason: Hunting stays open after the story.
trophies.guide:
1. Bret's hunting line starts in Lummox County after Chapter 2 and is Jason-only. [1][2]
2. Work through his Target Decks; all 15 are a strict 100% item anyway. [2][4]
3. Which unique animal triggers the trophy is unconfirmed, so finishing every deck is the safe route. [2]

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide:
1. Any three complete Collectible Card sets will do. [1][2]
2. PowerPyx counts 18 sets in total, so pick the three you are closest to (set count from its summary, unconfirmed). [1]

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide:
1. Scan 100 WAiNK spots: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. [1][2]
2. Landmarks, Curiosities and Sculptures give 89; top up with No Flusher tags. [2]

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide:
1. 80 challenges exist; any 50 earn it. [1][2]
2. The 100% checklist wants 70, so you can skip the ten hardest (such as Helipad Flyovers or Train Landing). [4]

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide:
1. With Jason and Lucia together, reach 4 stars and lose them. [1][2]
2. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a suggested hiding route. [1][2]
3. Chapter 4 vault jobs also give 4 stars, so it may come naturally there. [1]

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide:
1. With your partner, rob three shops one after another while still wanted. [1][2]
2. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City sit close enough to chain. [1][2]
3. PowerPyx notes the unlock can be delayed after the third shop (unconfirmed). [1]

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide:
1. Scan 100 different vehicles with WAiNK; you do not have to drive them. [1][2]
2. Stand by a busy road; keep going to 200 of 277 base models for 100%. [1][4]

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide:
1. Fill Combat Focus, trigger it and drop five enemies before it ends; an assault rifle helps. [1][2]
2. Gang members at an illegal operation count; police, soldiers and civilians reportedly do not. [1][2]

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide:
1. At VCIA, take a passenger jet parked at a boarding bridge; gates E3 and E4 are suggested. [1][2]
2. Take off and get roughly 1 km away for the pop. [1][2]

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide:
1. Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County. [1][2]
2. Take out enemies with it until the trophy pops. [1][2]

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide:
1. Get the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs. [2]
2. Enter a Vice City jewelry store from the back, cut the alarm and the camera footage, then open the safe. [1]
3. Richardson Jewelry is the suggested target. [1][2]

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.missableReason: Vaults stay open after the story.
trophies.guide:
1. Large-bank vaults open through an optional Chapter 4 mission. [1][2][4]
2. Rob 5 of the 8 vaults and escape; each one gives 4 stars. [1][2]
3. All 8 are needed for 100%, so finish the set. [2][4]

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide:
1. Hit an armored truck and get away. [1][2]
2. A large bank vault robbery reportedly counts too, once you escape the police or reach a Pay 'n' Spray. [1][2]

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide:
1. Clear every patch of fog from the Leonida map. [1][2]
2. A plane is fastest; sweep the map in lanes and check the edges for leftover fog. [1][2]

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide:
1. There are 9 gangs; rob one illegal operation from each. [1][2]
2. 39 operations exist and the 100% checklist wants all of them; the story marks 19 for you. [2][4]

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide:
1. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and order an Apple Martini. [1]
2. Drink it beside the bar with the view. [1]
3. GTABase still lists the exact steps as unconfirmed. [2]

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missBefore: Do not wreck the showroom's blue Banshee (unconfirmed)
trophies.missableReason: Reportedly only one specific car counts; unconfirmed whether it respawns.
trophies.guide:
1. Get the Key Cloner first. [1]
2. Take the blue Banshee in the southern Vice City showroom and drive it out through the window. [1]
3. GTABase lists exact steps as unconfirmed. [2]

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide:
1. After Chapter 2, go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn. [1][2]
2. Grab its three valuables. [1][2]
3. Lose the police; the trophy pops once you are clear. [1][2]

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide:
1. Max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. [1][2]
2. Work out together at fitness clubs to raise both at once. [1][2]

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missBefore: Before your criminal profile turns Irredeemable
trophies.missableReason: GTABase warns the Irredeemable criminal profile is permanent; plan the 500 actions with that in mind.
trophies.guide:
1. Build up 500 criminal-profile actions. [1][2]
2. Running pedestrians down speeds it up. [1]
3. GTABase warns the Irredeemable profile cannot be undone. [2]

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missBefore: Payday Loans in Little Cuba must still be robbable (unconfirmed)
trophies.missableReason: Steps come from one summary and are unconfirmed.
trophies.guide:
1. As Lucia alone, go back to the Little Cuba Payday Loans. [1]
2. Rob it a second time and escape on foot. [1]
3. GTABase marks the exact steps as unconfirmed. [2]

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missBefore: Random night event; keep a save nearby
trophies.guide:
1. Go alone to the area northwest of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County after 2 AM. [1]
2. Help the person being abducted by the UFO and drive her back to her car. [1]
3. GTABase only calls it a strange event and lists the steps as unconfirmed. [2]

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide:
1. On a bike, kick 10 pedestrians within 60 seconds. [1]
2. A crowded street makes it quick. [1]
3. GTABase lists the exact requirement as unconfirmed. [2]

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide:
1. Hand marked bills from robberies to fences; the total adds up across visits. [1][2]
2. Yasmani pays the best rate. [1][2]

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide:
1. Spend $100,000 in shops in total. [1][2]
2. Guns, car mods and tattoos burn money fastest. [1][2]

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide:
1. Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Real Estate app, about $160,000 in total. [1][2]
2. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count. [2]

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide:
1. Moses runs the Scooter Bros app from Port Gellhorn; register 10 vehicles through it. [1][2]
2. You need enough garage space, and early on only cars without trackers are accepted. [1]
